scope: Theorem 4.4 (Limiting satisfiability threshold) of the manuscript “Computing the Random 3-SAT Threshold” (preprints/Computing-the-Random-3-SAT-Threshold-September-27-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 235 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be7bde6cd4e513e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The limit α in Proposition 4.3 lies in [1/200, 10]. For every fixed real a ≥ 0, the relaxed Poisson model satisfies Pn(an) −→ {︄ 1, 0 ≤ a < α, 0, a > α. The same limits hold for p(n, ⌊an⌋) in the proper-clause model defined in the introduction. In particular its limiting density is α3 = α.
